Target modeled from daily high or substituted close and next open gaps; no bid/ask, displayed size, queue, halts or limit-fill proof.

No original daily equity path in retained trade rows; cannot independently reproduce drawdown/time-in-market or year mark-to-market returns. Preserve original summary separately.
